Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The agent produced an incomplete and inaccurate list of Daniel Craig movies under 150 minutes, omitting key titles such as Casino Royale (144 min), Skyfall (143 min), Spectre (148 min), Quantum of Solace (106 min), Knives Out (130 min), Defiance (137 min), and Logan Lucky (118 min). This flawed filtering skewed the candidate set from the outset and led to unsubstantiated availability checks, culminating in the incorrect conclusion that “Road to Perdition” is the highest-rated qualifying movie on Netflix US.
